lines.1: The Athletics and Martial Arts Festival--
lines.2: The first day was a relatively ordinary athletics festival.
lines.4: Subaru Date: first place in the boys' sprint.
lines.6: 「Damn... I still can't beat you on the track...」
lines.7: Kinu Kanisawa: first place in the girls' obstacle race.
lines.9: 「Ohhh. Guess being quick on your feet pays off.」
lines.10: Igaguri: second place in the home-run contest.
lines.11: 「Damn! I lost to that buzz-cut guy from 2-A!」
lines.12: 「Second place is plenty good. Don't sweat it.」
lines.13: Yoshimi Sato and Erika Kiriya: first place in the girls' three-legged race.
lines.14: 「We're the hottest couple around right now.」
lines.15: 「Your scavenger race is next, right, Tsushima? Good luck.」
lines.18: Okay, what did my card say?
lines.21: I hurried toward the section where my class was cheering.
lines.22: 「I knew I could count on my class. So many to choose from.」
